response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong systems and full-stack skills, but his career has centered on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile stacks rather than Java/Kotlin/JVM enterprise development. He lacks demonstrated recent depth in Spring, Kotlin, or IDE internals, which are core requirements for this role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Proven track record building complex, high-performance, large-scale systems (e.g., low-latency DLang services at Sociomantic)
Strong communication/teaching skills evidenced by workshops, talks, and mentoring
concerns: No recent or substantial Java/Kotlin/Spring enterprise experience listed
No evidence of IDE internals, language tooling, or JVM-specific tooling work
Skills list and recent roles (2018-present) are dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, not JVM ecosystem

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling experience
Strong general software engineering craftsmanship and large-scale systems experience
